note: SNG-230 Phase 4 content (Aevi 2026-07-22): the ward-denials (§7b) and challenge-premises (§7c) the engine checks read. Authored as a LAYER (ability_id -> denies/breakDC; challenge premise -> trivializedBy/resistDC) rather than editing 18 ability files surgically. CCode's frameModel/collapse-path looks up an ability's ward-denial here, and a challenge's premise here. Function families use the 24-verb vocab (ward/shield/resist/finish/end/move/know/reveal/foresee/...). Fields match the frame contract (engine/encounterFrame.js). Ability ids verified against Silas's sheet + core abilities.

wardDenials._doc: ability_id -> {denies:[function families this ward makes INAPPLICABLE, not just resisted], breakDC:the margin a collapse attempt must DEMOLISH by to break the ward and apply anyway, breakBand:the resolver degree required to break}. A denied mechanic simply cannot fire while the ward holds; only a demolishing roll breaks it.

the_shielding_word.flavor: The Shielding Word speaks a NO over you that a killing stroke cannot argue with — an instakill does not land, it is refused. Only a stroke that demolishes the word (a crit-margin above its tier) reaches past it.

the_warding_mark.flavor: The Warding Mark turns a finishing blow into an ordinary one — the mark denies the KILL, not the hit. A demolishing strike breaks the mark and the finisher applies.

boundary_stone.flavor: The Boundary Stone denies passage and pursuit — a transit-collapse of a chase (a shadowstep-away, a grey-road exit) simply does not open across it. Only a demolishing move breaks the bound.

the_kept_breath.flavor: The Kept Breath holds a life past the moment it should end — an instant-death mechanic finds nothing to end. The strongest of Silas's denials; only an overwhelming stroke reaches the kept breath.

challengePremises._doc: challenge premise -> {barrier:what makes it hard, trivializedBy:[function families that VOID the premise -> trivial bypass below resistDC], resistDC:the difficulty above which even a voiding skill must roll OPPOSED, acknowledgeTone:the §8 'little mention' shape when a kit trivializes it}. A challenge with a matching premise checks the player's kit: premise-voided + below resistDC -> trivial bypass (with the named acknowledgment); premise-voided + at/above resistDC -> opposed roll; not voided -> normal stages.

physical_ascent.barrier: a wall, cliff, or height to climb
physical_ascent.acknowledgeTone: name the movement craft making nothing of the height — 'your wings make nothing of the wall; you're over it before it was a question'
physical_ascent.note: A fly/transit craft (Marrow's Wings, shadowstep) voids a low climb. A WARDED height (resistDC 40+, e.g. warded against flight) stays a real opposed climb.

locked_barrier.barrier: a sealed door, lock, or physical obstruction
locked_barrier.acknowledgeTone: name the craft that made the barrier irrelevant — 'the lock was never going to hold; you simply go around what it guards'
locked_barrier.note: An unmake/transit craft voids a simple lock; a hard-warded seal resists (opposed).

pattern_puzzle.barrier: a puzzle, cipher, or pattern to solve
pattern_puzzle.acknowledgeTone: name the insight craft laying the answer out — 'the pattern lays itself out under Order-Sense; the lock was never going to hold against you'
pattern_puzzle.note: A high KNOW/reveal/foresee craft lays out a SIMPLE puzzle whole (trivial). A HARD puzzle (resistDC 50+) resists even the right skill -> opposed roll. Erik: 'simple puzzles trivial, harder puzzles opposed rolls.'

hidden_thing.barrier: something concealed, a trap, an ambush, a hidden path
hidden_thing.acknowledgeTone: name the perceiving craft that saw through it — 'nothing stays hidden from you here; the ambush was over before it sprang'
hidden_thing.note: A reveal/track craft voids a simple concealment; a well-hidden or warded thing resists.

closed_distance.barrier: a gap, a chase, a thing fleeing or fled
closed_distance.acknowledgeTone: name the movement craft closing it instantly — 'the distance means nothing to you; you're beside them before they know it'
closed_distance.note: A fast transit/track craft can collapse a CHASE (close the gap instantly). A movement-warded quarry (boundary_stone-like) resists -> opposed.

collapseEligibility._doc: tier -> whether a FINISH/END-family collapse (instant-end) can fire, and its base collapseDC. Riffraff freely collapsible; epics NON-collapsible (no one-beat kill on a dragon - fight the stages). Read against the finisher's opposed roll AND any wardDenial on the target.

riffraff.note: a finisher likely ends it in one beat

notable.note: collapsible but resists - an opposed roll; a solid fail still damages (§7a)

regional.note: only a demolishing finisher collapses; usually you fight the stages

epic.note: NON-collapsible - no one-beat kill on an epic/dragon. The finisher does damage per §7a but never collapses the frame. You fight the stages, together.
